description: Perched in the desirable Stanford Heights neighborhood, this home offers spectacular water views, and a spacious open floor plan designed for comfortable and serene living. The recently updated main living level features a bright, open floor plan with living, dining, 3 bedrooms, and a gourmet kitchen that captures the views of the bay and the surrounding mountains. Flowing seamlessly outside is an oversized water view deck, perfect for morning coffee, sunset gatherings, or simply enjoying the iconic Bay backdrop. Generously sized bedrooms provide ample comfort and storage, while the home's thoughtful layout balances openness with privacy. In-unit laundry, secure garage parking, and additional storage space provides daily necessities and luxuries with ease. This unique property features a recently renovated studio room with its own separate street entrance, that features an en-suite bathroom, storage, and an abundance of natural light. This versatile space is ideal for a variety of useful functions, such as an in-law guest suite, home gym, or large home office. Located just minutes from Sausalito's waterfront restaurants, cafe's, and amenities, this home is also surrounded by hiking trails, aquatic activities, and also within minutes of San Francisco. This home combines quintessential Bay views with flexibility and everyday livability in one of Marin's most sought-after communities - come see this beauty for yourself!
